sentences.text: WW-Marine Power Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-23 under the industry code 43210, electrical installation.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-30.
The tax-register records give first sales on 2026-11-01 and a first hire on 2026-11-30, which are later than the date of this export.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a marine word but the registered industry is electrical installation.
